reason: The remediation only edits a single line in /etc/default/useradd to set the INACTIVE value. This is a standard STIG hardening step, does not modify kernel, bootloader, or partitioning, and carries minimal risk of service disruption. Properly setting a numeric value will not lock out existing sessions and can be validated quickly.
estimated_impact: authentication/authorization affected; Potential account lockout if an inappropriate INACTIVE value is set; Misconfiguration could affect future password expiration handling
